sentences.text: " 1. Heard learned counsel for the applicants; learned AGA for the State and perused the records.

2. The present application under Section 438 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking anticipatory bail apprehending arrest in FIR No.407 of 2015 under sections 420, 467,
477-A, 120-B, 109 IPC, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Bahraich.

3. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that on the basis of the suspicious orders,
various persons were benefited and their names were included wrongly.
4. The counsel for the applicants argues that the entries are carried out through government records which have not been set aside, as such, allegations are baseless.
It is further argued that even otherwise, no specific allegation of manipulating any government orders have been alleged against the applicants even in the FIR.
It is also argued that one of the co-accused was granted the regular bail by this court vide order dated 22.05.2024.
5. Learned AGA opposes the anticipatory bail application and seeks time to file the objection.

6. Considering these facts, the applicants are entitled for the benefit of anticipatory bail more so when the allegations have to be established based upon the documents which are alleged to be suspicious.

7. Thus, it is directed that the applicants Anita Devi, Reeta Devi, Anil Kumar and Dinesh Kumar @ Dinesh Kumar Shukla shall not be arrested till the next date of listing in pursuance of the aforesaid FIR in question, on their furnishing a personal bond of Rs.30,000/- to the satisfaction of Station House Officer concerned with the following conditions:
(i) That the accused-applicants shall make himself available for interrogation by police authorities as and when required and will cooperate with the investigation;
(ii) That the accused-applicants shall not, directly or indirectly make any inducement,
threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the court or to any police officer; and (iii) That the accused-applicants shall not leave India without the previous permission of the Court.
8. Learned AGA may file objection within four weeks.

9. List on 12.09.2024. "

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A submits that charge-sheet has been filed way back in the year 2016.

On due consideration to the fact that the applicants were not arrested during investigation, charge-sheet has been filed in the matter so also the judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of "Mahdoom Bava v. CBI, 2023 SCC OnLine SC 299", the interim protection granted vide order dated 7.8.2024 is made absolute in view of dictum of Apex Court in re: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98.
